"Progear" is a new type of shooter where elaborate story settings and fantastic visuals are blended each other. Ships and special attachments called "Gun Flyers" can be combined in various ways. You must make good use of two different attack modes "Forward- intensive Fighter Mode" and "Multi-direction Gunner Mode" depending on the battle situation. To aim for a high score, you will also need to utilize features like "Jeweling" which bombs and turns enemy shots into jewels and "Jeweling Tractor Effect" which retrieves all the jewels at once.
